expected.labelNote: The deepest cause is java.net.ConnectException: Connection refused, which the taxonomy puts in NETWORK_ERROR and explicitly keeps out of TIMEOUT. The wrapping status is gRPC UNAVAILABLE from a dependency that never accepted the RPC, so DEPENDENCY_FAILURE is acceptable if the status code is treated as a failed downstream call. Primary is NETWORK_ERROR because connection refused is named.
